name: lucarne-widget
description: The reusable glassmorphic in-page widget infrastructure: a shadow-DOM + sandboxed-iframe injector, a versioned identity-stamped envelope, a Node-side WidgetHost (push/onIntent/every), a framework-free iframe runtime (createWidget), an optional Preact adapter, and an esbuild srcdoc build helper. Zero app knowledge — every name is namespaced by a caller-supplied `ns`.
author: Aaron Volter
